column1: # One line per model column (subtool). family = adapter in bench/adapters/<family>.py; arg = what that adapter needs
# (Dorado: the modification model in $DORADO_MODELS; UniMeth: 'checkpoint;flags;frequency', ${KEY} = setting KEY;
# MethyNano: the species checkpoint folder; RawMod: see config/rawmod_models.tsv).
# UniMeth: the released 5 kHz models, run at --frequency 5khz.
# unimeth_r81_* (UniMeth-FT in the paper): UniMeth fine-tuned from the released 5 kHz models with labels only at the
# positions the released RawMod model trained on (evaluation/train_unimeth_ft.sh), run with the patched source
# codes = which per-read modification codes count as "modified" for this column (comma-separated; * = any).
# bases = + strand bases the subtool has a model for; context = cpg (CpG-only model) or any. A subtool is N/A on a
# row whose modified base it does not model, or (context cpg) on a non-CpG row; it is never scored there.
